Reloaded and resumed project 1. The same pending event returned; resolved its free cap-unlock choice.
Used the pause-and-create flow to start project 2, 现实里的小作品, micro real mode, seed 99002.
After one week in each project, switched between them. Each retained its work, jobs, and week 2; both used the current shared balance 7084 rather than the older balance 7342.
Reloaded with project 1 active and project 2 paused, then switched back to project 2.
Played project 2 for six more weeks to complete materials and review, choosing free cap-unlock event options. Released after seven development weeks without requiring other modules to reach 100%.
Created and terminated project 3, 放弃的实验, without advancing a week.
Created and paused project 4, 留待明天的点子, without advancing a week. Resumed project 1.
Reloaded the rebuilt final UI and verified four records and the shared balance were retained.
Verified active, paused, aborted, and released filters each show the single corresponding product.
Expanded the released product's module progress and team, opened its settlement report while project 1 remained active, and returned through 查看开发历史. Shared funds and experience remained unchanged.
limits: One manually played release is a workflow check, not a win-rate or economy-balance estimate.
